summary: Focused re-verification of two deployment fixes plus regression on login and POS inventory. All targets pass. (1) Login screen fields now start EMPTY (verified via input_value == '' for both testIDs); typing admin@gudang.com/admin123 logs in successfully and redirects to /(tabs) (Terima Barang screen visible). Empty submit shows toast 'Isi email dan password' and stays on the login screen. (2) GET /api/pos/inventory returns 200 with unchanged shape {count, items:[{barcode,name,stock,cost,price}]} after projection + limit(1000) — verified live: count=7, sample rows show Aqua 600ml stock=41 cost=2000 price=3500 and Indomie Goreng stock=39 cost=2600 price=3000, reflecting prior approved receipts. Regression: full pytest suite still 21/21 pass, including login success/invalid-password/401-me and POS inventory sync after approval. No red-screen, no CORS errors on preview URL. Only carry-over item: RN-Web deprecation console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (same as iteration_1, cosmetic).

issues: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' persists (cosmetic, RN-Web 0.19+).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:500 — pos_inventory now uses field projection {barcode,name,stock,cost,price} + sort(name) + limit(1000). Response shape unchanged for frontend consumers. Good.
login.tsx:34-35 — useState("") for both email and password. Confirmed no hardcoded pre-fill. Good.
Note: /api/pos/inventory with limit(1000) may become insufficient at large catalog scale (>1000 SKUs). Consider pagination if the catalog is expected to exceed a few thousand products.
